GENERAL
The Overhaul Materials Manual (OMat) identifies, and provides a guide for purchasing consumable materials.
The materials are only approved for use when instructed by Rolls-Royce, Repair, Overhaul, or Maintenance documentation.
HEALTH, SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT, AND TECHNICAL DATA
For Health, Safety, and Environmental information, contact the material supplier. It is the responsibility of the material user to obtain the appropriate Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) before the item is used and obey the instructions.
ALTERNATIVE MATERIALS
Approved alternative materials are shown with an alpha suffix attached to the prime number. These may be used whenever the prime number is instructed.

Note

There may be differences in application techniques for the alternative materials.
If the engine manual calls up the alpha suffix item then this item must be used and the alternative alpha suffixes cannot be used.
If the basic item number is called-up as a mandatory application, it will be highlighted as such with an asterisk.
Alternative masking tapes can be used provided the user tests and approves them in accordance with TASK 70–00–00–300–369 Overhaul Process 369 - Masking Tape (iSpec2200:Dahlewitz Common (2200):TSD-594-J:EM:TSD-594-J:task:task-700000300369).
Suppliers of alternative products not listed in the OMat manual must have ISO9001 or AS9100 approval.
SHELF LIFE
Consumable materials may deteriorate before being required for use, therefore, shelf lives (S.L.) are quoted. Storage conditions can significantly affect the shelf life, therefore, further guidance should be obtained from the material manufacturer.
TRANSPORT LIMITATIONS
The supplier will be able to provide details of the transport limitations
SPECIFICATIONS
Material must be released to one of the specifications shown in the Manufacturers Reference and/or Specification column. Specifications in brackets are for reference only and the product does not need to be released to these specifications.
Data in the "Packing, Transport, Shelf Life and Remarks" column is for information only and does not restrict the size or form of packaging which can be used.
SUPPLIERS
The products specified in the OMat can be purchased from the companies in the Suppliers column of OMat which lists manufactures and stockists.
Where a listed manufacturer has authorised distributors not listed in the OMat, these agents can be used. The manufacturer's web site should give details of their authorised distributors.
It is permitted to use stockists to source OMat items from the approved suppliers if the stockist has valid ISO 9001 approval. The certificate of conformity (CoC) must be traceable to the original approved manufacturer.
The following Consumable Supply Agents can provide a range of OMat materials:
UK.10 - Med-Lab --- All Sections
UK.261 or NA.2 - Indestructible Paints (U.K. and U.S.A.) --- Paints, Adhesives, General Supplies
AS.45 - Hypercoat Enterprises (Asia) --- Indestructible Paints products
UK.448 - LPW Technology --- Laser cladding powders
LOCAL Suppliers
Where the OMat manual calls up LOCAL in the Suppliers column then the material can be purchased from any supplier provided the product meets the specification listed.
For consumables, purchased from a LOCAL source, if a CoC is not available, traceability of the consumable must be demonstrated by a photograph of the consumable used e.g. marker pen, showing the relevant identification e.g. trade name, serial number, batch number, international specification etc.
The various consumable categories in the OMat manual are treated as follows:-
General chemicals. For these consumables you can use local suppliers. For example OMat 106 DMC-ROLLSROYCE-OMAT-00-50-70-01A00-941A-DSU-PP--o-ma-t10-6 Sodium Hydroxide.
Trade Name consumables. These consumables must be purchased from the manufacturers listed or their stockists. The trade name product (or those listed in the alpha suffix approved alternatives) must be used. Self approved alternatives cannot be used. For example OMat 4/52 DMC-ROLLSROYCE-OMAT-00-50-70-04A00-941A-DSU-PP--o-ma-t4--52 Dry Film Anti-Scuffing Spray, Rocol Dry Moly Spray. You must use Rocol Dry Moly Spray.
Even if an international specification is listed the alternatives to the trade name cannot be used. For example OMat 175 DMC-ROLLSROYCE-OMAT-00-50-70-01A00-941A-DSU-PP--o-ma-t17-5 Chromate conversion coating for aluminium, Bonderite M-CR Alcrm 1200 Aero, Def Stan 03-18, MIL-DTL-81706 you must use Bonderite M-CR or Alcrm 1200 Aero not just any product that meets MIL-DTL-81706.
International Specifications. These can be purchased from suppliers who can meet the international specification. For example OMat 1005E DMC-ROLLSROYCE-OMAT-00-50-70-10A00-941A-DSU-PP--o-ma-t10-05E Temporary Rust Preventative, must meet MiL-PRF-16173 grade 2 or Mil-C-11796 class 3 or AMS3079.
Materials which form part of the component. These can be purchased through stockists but must be released to the specification quoted. For example OMat 3/252 DMC-ROLLSROYCE-OMAT-00-50-70-03A00-941A-DSU-PP--o-ma-t3--252 Metal Spray Powder AlSi-BN, Metco 320 NS, MSRR9507/66. This must be released to MSRR 9507/66. (If the MSRR specification is in brackets then the product will not be released to the MSRR.)
However where there are alpha suffixes these can be used as alternatives to the product in the prime number.
Abrasive papers and Polishing Stones: Where the OMat manual calls out specific dimensions in the remarks, alternative sizes can be purchased providing the product grade meets the specification listed e.g. Particle size 82 microns. 280x230mm sheets. Particle size 82 microns 500x700mm can be purchased.
